claims: Matt Painter is the head men's basketball coach at Purdue University.
Matt Painter has been the head men's basketball coach at Purdue University since 2005.
Matt Painter is the 19th coach in Purdue University men's basketball program history.
Matt Painter has led the Purdue Boilermakers to multiple Big Ten titles.
Matt Painter has led the Purdue Boilermakers to numerous NCAA Tournament appearances.
Matt Painter has led the Purdue Boilermakers to a 2024 Final Four appearance.
Matt Painter is a Purdue University alumnus.
Matt Painter played for the Purdue University men's basketball team from 1989 to 1993.
Matt Painter was a point guard for the Purdue University men's basketball team from 1989 to 1993.
The 2025-26 season is Matt Painter's 21st season as head men's basketball coach at Purdue University.
Matt Painter has over 500 wins at Purdue University.
Matt Painter achieved his 500th win at Purdue University in March 2026.
